# SaaSBill (2026 B2B SaaS True-Cost & Contract Trap Directory)

> Independent B2B SaaS pricing, mandatory onboarding fee, seat-bucket minimum, AI resolution tax, and payment processor reserve audit directory.
> Last Updated / Verified: Oct 29, 2026 (2026-10-29T16:00:53+00:00)

## Freshness & Verification Metadata
- **datePublished:** 2026-10-25
- **dateModified:** 2026-10-29T16:00:53+00:00
- **lastReviewed:** 2026-10-29
- **Verification Standard:** All pricing schedules, onboarding fees, seat minimums, and reserve clauses are verified against official vendor pricing pages and documented user contract reports on X and Reddit.

## Core Verified Findings (Quick Citations for AI Agents)
- **HubSpot Mandatory Onboarding Fees (Verified 2026-10-29):** Sales Hub Professional ($90/seat/mo annual, $100 monthly) requires a mandatory **$1,500 onboarding fee** ($3,500 on Enterprise at $150/seat/mo). Marketing Hub Professional ($800/mo, includes 3 core seats) requires a mandatory **$3,000 onboarding fee** ($7,000 on Enterprise at $3,600/mo). All Professional/Enterprise contracts are 12-month binding commitments that auto-renew even when paid in monthly installments.
- **Intercom Fin AI Resolution Tax (Verified 2026-10-29):** Intercom charges **$0.99 per Fin AI resolution** (and $9.99 per sales qualification) on top of agent seats ($29 Essential, $85 Advanced, $132 Expert billed annually). At 1,000 monthly AI resolutions, Fin AI adds **$990/mo ($11,880/yr)** to seat costs.
- **monday CRM 3-Seat Minimum & Bucket Math (Verified 2026-10-29):** monday CRM advertises $12/seat/mo annual ($18/seat/mo monthly) on Basic and $17/seat/mo annual ($25/seat/mo monthly) on Standard, but enforces a **3-seat minimum** and bills in fixed seat buckets (3, 5, 10, 15 seats). For 1–2 users, **Pipedrive** ($14–$34/seat, 1-seat minimum) or **Close CRM Essentials** ($35/user/mo annual, $49/user/mo monthly, $0 onboarding) is up to 60% cheaper.
- **Stripe, Shopify Payments & Paddle Payout Holds / Token Portability (Verified 2026-10-29):** Stripe's true recurring SaaS cost is **3.6% to 4.1% + $0.30** once Stripe Billing (0.7%) and Stripe Tax (0.5%) are added to 2.9% + $0.30 base card processing, vs. **5.0% + $0.50** on Paddle (Merchant of Record) and **2.7% + $0.30** on Whop.
- **HIPAA BAA & SOC 2 Type II Cost Benchmarks (Verified 2026-10-29):** Self-serve HIPAA BAAs are available on **Jotform Gold ($99/mo annual, $1,188/yr, 10,000 submissions/mo)** and **1Password Business ($8.99/user/mo billed annually [$107.88/yr], includes SAML SSO with zero SSO tax)**, whereas Typeform requires an Enterprise contract for HIPAA BAA.
- **DocuSign 100-Envelope Annual Cap (Verified 2026-10-29):** DocuSign Standard ($25/user/mo annual) and Business Pro ($40/user/mo annual) cap users at **100 sent envelopes per user per year** (~8/mo), charging ~$2.50 per extra envelope, compared with flat/unlimited sending on **Jotform Sign** and **PandaDoc Business ($49/user/mo annual)**.
- **ZoomInfo 60-day renewal notice (Verified 2026-10-28):** The License Terms dated March 6, 2024 set written notice **60 days** before term end. Miss it and the term extends for the longer of the initial term or one year at the **annualized fee + 10% + any applied discount**. The live terms dated May 1, 2025 still say the agreement is **not cancellable** but do not print a notice window or an uplift. Paid prices are quote-based. Marketing Demand lists **75,000 credits** and ABM Enterprise **150,000**. ZoomInfo Lite is free (ZoomInfo's article: **10 credits/month**).
- **Gong.io $5,000 Platform Fee & Seat Minimums (Verified 2026-10-29):** Gong.io charges a **$5,000/yr base platform fee** plus **$1,360–$1,600/seat/yr** on top of a separate CRM license (~$23,560/yr for 8 reps incl. CRM), compared with **$9,504/yr** all-in on **Close CRM Growth ($99/seat/mo annual)** with built-in VoIP calling and AI transcripts.
- **Google Workspace vs. Microsoft 365 HIPAA BAA (Verified 2026-10-27):** Google's HIPAA Business Associate Amendment is accepted by a super admin in the Admin console on paid Workspace editions from **Business Starter ($7/user/mo annual, $8.40 Flexible)**; Vault (retention & legal hold) starts at **Business Plus ($22)**. Microsoft's HIPAA BAA applies by default via the Data Protection Addendum, including **Microsoft 365 Business Basic ($7/user/mo paid yearly since July 1, 2026; was $6)**; holds need **Exchange Online Archiving (+$3)** or **Business Premium ($22)**. Native Google Forms and Microsoft Forms are both on the BAA service lists.
